patch_description: The current approach uses 10 perturbed square-grid starts, tiny initial radii, numerical finite-difference derivatives, 900 SLSQP iterations, and a uniform feasibility shrink. This version retains the successful 5x5-plus-interstice scaffold but adds analytic Jacobians for all 325 pair constraints and 104 wall constraints, allowing more accurate SLSQP steps at lower derivative cost. It uses a mixture of grid and staggered layered starts, slightly larger feasible initial radii, 1200 iterations, and a final continuation polish from the best candidate. The explicit certification pass keeps the returned packing valid despite optimizer tolerances.
